environment.description: Node.js Apollo GraphQL server running behind an HAProxy 2.4 reverse proxy in TCP mode (mode tcp) with no layer-7 inspection. PostgreSQL 14 direct connection (no connection pooler). HAProxy forwards raw TCP streams without HTTP normalization. Server runs on ECS Fargate with default networking, no WAF, no API gateway. The application connects directly to RDS PostgreSQL with the pg driver using simple query protocol.

config.database: PostgreSQL 14 RDS, direct connection via pg driver simple query protocol
config.network: ECS Fargate, public ALB with no AWS WAF
config.http_parsing: Express default body parser, no request normalization
